description: Multi-source scrape registry. Each entry maps a logical source to seed URLs, corpus docId, and adapter id. Bible/catechism keep legacy npm scripts; new docs use scrape_source.ts.

sources.title: Biblia (Pueblo de Dios)
sources.notes: Full scrape still via `npm run biblia`. Adapter is a registry stub until a future rewrite.

sources.title: Catecismo de la Iglesia Católica
sources.notes: Full scrape still via `npm run catecismo`. Adapter is a registry stub until a future rewrite.

sources.title: Lumen gentium
sources.notes: Single-page Vatican II dogmatic constitution. Numbered §§1–69.

sources.title: Gaudium et spes
sources.notes: Pastoral constitution. Numbered §§1–93 (approx).

sources.title: Dei verbum
sources.notes: Dogmatic constitution on divine revelation. Numbered §§1–26.

sources.title: Sacrosanctum Concilium
sources.notes: Constitution on the Sacred Liturgy. Numbered §§1–130.

sources.title: Unitatis redintegratio
sources.notes: Decree on Ecumenism (Vat. II). Numbered §§1–24. Official path uses decree_ (not const_).

sources.title: Apostolicam actuositatem
sources.notes: Decree on the Apostolate of the Laity (Vat. II). Numbered §§1–33. Official path uses decree_ (not const_).

sources.title: Compendio de la Doctrina Social de la Iglesia
sources.notes: Single-page Compendium of the Social Doctrine of the Church. Numbered §§1–583. Dual markup (named anchors + bare bold numbers).

sources.title: Código de Derecho Canónico
sources.notes: 1983 Code of Canon Law (Latin Church). Multi-page (~251). docCode CDC (not CIC — CIC is the Catechism in this repo). ~1744 canons (some numbers reserved/abrogated in source HTML). Markup: N, N., Can. N -, bare leading numbers.
